user.title: Google TV Streamer Media Aggregator
user.description: Optionally enter a TMDb API key (v3) or API Read Access Token (v4). It is used to look up posters for movies and TV shows. You can add it later via Reconfigure.

data_description.tmdb_api_key: Get one at https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api. Leave blank to only use cached and per-app fallback images.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure TMDb
reconfigure.description: Change the TMDb API key. Clear the field to stop using TMDb.

reauth_confirm.title: TMDb API key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: TMDb rejected the configured API key. Enter a new key, or leave blank to stop using TMDb.

abort.already_configured: The integration is already configured. Add players with the "Add aggregated player" button.
abort.single_instance_allowed: The integration is already configured. Add players with the "Add aggregated player" button.
abort.reauth_successful: The TMDb API key was updated.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The TMDb API key was updated.

init.title: Aggregator settings
init.description: These settings apply to all aggregated players. Per-app fallback images can be placed in the `default_apps` folder inside the cache directory (e.g. `default_apps/stremio.jpg`).

data_description.video_threshold_minutes: Media longer than this (or of unknown length) is treated as a movie/TV show; shorter media is treated as music and skipped.
data_description.cache_enabled: Store downloaded artwork on disk and serve it from there. When off, TMDb image URLs are used directly.
data_description.cache_dir: Must be inside a media directory or allowlist_external_dirs. Default: /media/tv-streamer-media/
data_description.tmdb_language: Language for TMDb lookups, e.g. en-AU. Leave blank for the TMDb default.

error.cache_dir_not_absolute: The cache directory must be an absolute path.
error.cache_dir_not_allowed: This path is not allowed. Use a path under a media directory or add it to allowlist_external_dirs.
error.cache_dir_not_writable: The cache directory could not be created or is not writable.

user.title: Add aggregated player
user.description: Pick the Google TV Streamer media player to wrap. A new media player will mirror it and add artwork.

data_description.source_entity_id: The media player of the Google TV Streamer.
data_description.name: Leave blank to use the source name with "Aggregated" appended (entity ID media_player.<source>_aggregated).
data_description.stremio_entity_id: Optional media player from the Stremio integration. Used to look up artwork by IMDb ID when the source is running Stremio. Leave empty to use the default aggregator for Stremio.
data_description.stremio_app_ids: App IDs or app names that identify Stremio on the source.
data_description.app_filter_mode: Restrict which apps the default aggregator looks up artwork for.
data_description.app_filter_list: App IDs or names for the filter. Pick from apps seen before or type your own (comma separated is fine).
data_description.prefer_source_image: If the source already provides an image, use it instead of looking one up.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure aggregated player
reconfigure.description: Changing the name updates the device name; the entity ID is kept.
